about: Game animation library for the VRoid characters. Kimodo entries (with a prompt) are generated on the DGX Spark by living/tools/kimodo/spark.sh and made game-ready by animate.py --library; keyed entries are animate.py's hand-keyed CLIPS. See the header of animate.py for every field. layer: upper plays the clip on the spine, arms and head only while the body moves, over its gait (the game's anim.rs); without it, or standing, the whole body plays it.

clips.name: stand
clips.prompt: a person stands still in a relaxed neutral pose, arms hanging at the sides

clips.name: idle
clips.prompt: a person stands idle, breathing calmly and shifting weight slightly

clips.name: idle_look
clips.prompt: a person stands and looks around curiously

clips.name: walk
clips.prompt: a person walks forward casually

clips.name: walk_brisk
clips.prompt: a person walks forward briskly

clips.name: run
clips.prompt: a person runs forward

clips.name: run_fast
clips.prompt: a person runs forward fast

clips.name: sneak
clips.prompt: a person sneaks forward slowly in a crouch

clips.name: talk
clips.prompt: a person talks with hand gestures while standing

clips.name: talk_explain
clips.prompt: a person explains something enthusiastically, gesturing with both hands

clips.name: listen
clips.prompt: a person stands and listens attentively, nodding now and then

clips.name: wave
clips.prompt: a person waves hello with the right hand

clips.name: point
clips.prompt: a person points forward with the right hand

clips.name: nod
clips.note: hand-keyed on the neutral pose: every Kimodo nod (4 seeds) was a deep bow, head 32-60 degrees down

clips.name: shake_head
clips.note: hand-keyed on the neutral pose: three of four Kimodo seeds barely turned the head, the fourth tipped it down

clips.name: sit_down
clips.prompt: a person sits down on a chair

clips.name: sit_idle
clips.prompt: a person sits on a chair, relaxed and idle

clips.name: stand_up
clips.prompt: a person stands up from a chair

clips.name: gather
clips.prompt: a person bends down to a low bush, picks berries with both hands and puts them in a bag at the hip, then straightens up
clips.note: town life: gathering at a field, a garden or a fishing spot

clips.name: work
clips.prompt: a person stands at a table kneading dough with both hands, pressing and folding it over and over without pausing
clips.note: town life: keeping a stall or a workshop door, cooking, tending. Clip lab 2026-11-11: kneading at a table; s22 has both hands busy 67% and some hand moving 86% of the clip (the old s2: 47%)

clips.name: eat
clips.prompt: a person stands and eats a piece of bread held in the right hand, taking small bites
clips.note: town life

clips.name: play
clips.prompt: a child hops and skips playfully on the spot, swinging the arms
clips.note: town life: children at play. Clip lab 2026-11-11: the same prompt, new seeds; s34 hops twice (feet clear 9.5 cm, 0.27 s in the air) with the toes at most 1.3 cm under the floor (the old s2: one hop, 5.8 cm under)

clips.name: sit_ground_down
clips.prompt: a person sits down on the floor and crosses their legs
clips.note: town life: resting in the square or at the inn. Clip lab 2026-11-11: the only take of 52 (6 prompts and lengths) that passes: hands never under the floor (the old s0: 8.9 cm), toes at most 1.1 cm; ends seated cross-legged, hands on the knees, hips at [-0.019, -0.401]

clips.name: sit_ground
clips.prompt: a person sitting cross-legged on the ground chats with someone beside them, gesturing with the hands and turning the head
clips.note: town life; offset is sit_ground_down s54's end. Clip lab 2026-11-11: still calm. Of 68 takes (8 prompts, keyed at both ends or cut from a cycle) s63 moves most: a hand or the head moves 30% of the time, still for 0.6 s at most, the head turns 11 degrees (the old s0: 11%, 4.4 s, 1 degree). Kimodo barely animates a seated body

clips.name: stand_up_ground
clips.prompt: a person sitting cross-legged on the ground rocks forward onto the feet and stands up
clips.note: town life: a sitter gets up before walking; starts where sit_ground_down ends (s54) and stands up over the origin. Clip lab 2026-11-11: the only take of 56 that passes: it rocks forward onto the feet, wrists, palms and knuckles above the floor (the old s0: knuckles under it, feet sliding 9.0 cm/s p90, drift 7.3 cm); slide 5.9 cm/s, drift 2.1 cm; Kimodo's relaxed fingertips touch 4.6 cm through the floor for a moment, for the retarget to bend

clips.name: sword_slash
clips.prompt: a person swings a one-handed sword in a fast diagonal slash from the right shoulder down to the left hip

clips.name: sword_overhead
clips.prompt: a person raises a one-handed sword high above the head and strikes down hard in front

clips.name: sword_thrust
clips.prompt: a person thrusts a sword forward with the right hand

clips.name: block
clips.prompt: a person quickly raises the left forearm in front of the face to block a blow, then lowers it

clips.name: dodge
clips.prompt: a person dodges with a quick low dash forward, then recovers to standing
clips.note: combat: the rules dash 2.6 m at 5.2 m/s (dodge_dist, dodge_speed); the hips follow that track (2.72 SOMA m is 2.6 game m at k_game 0.956), and travel: path takes exactly it out (planted feet pinned along it), so the body's own motion carries the dash

clips.name: hit
clips.prompt: a person is hit in the chest and staggers back

clips.name: death
clips.prompt: a person is struck, collapses where they stand and falls to the ground, dead
clips.note: the hips stay over the origin (path), so the body falls where it stands

clips.name: cast
clips.prompt: a person casts a spell, thrusting both hands forward

clips.name: attack
clips.note: hand-keyed: an in-place guard, strike, guard loop for repeated swings; the Kimodo sword clips are one-shots from the neutral pose

clips.name: bow_shoot
clips.prompt: a person draws a bow and shoots an arrow

clips.name: turn_left_90
clips.prompt: a person turns 90 degrees to the left on the spot in two steps
clips.note: two steps (left, then right), no overshoot; ends facing 90 degrees left in the neutral pose, so no ease out to the forward-facing neutral

clips.name: turn_right_90
clips.prompt: a person turns 90 degrees to the right on the spot in two steps
clips.note: two steps (right, then left); ends facing 90 degrees right in the neutral pose

clips.name: turn_left_180
clips.prompt: a person turns around to the left on the spot in three steps
clips.note: three steps (left, right, left); the hips' heading is pinned to a steady turn from 0.3 s to 1.7 s

clips.name: turn_right_180
clips.prompt: a person turns around to the right on the spot in three steps
clips.note: three steps (right, left, right); the hips' heading is pinned to a steady turn from 0.3 s to 1.7 s

clips.name: walk_start
clips.prompt: a person standing still starts walking forward, stepping off with the right foot
clips.note: right step, left step, ends as the left heel comes down in walk#1's frame 100 (half a cycle after the loop's start) at walk#1's speed; the hips follow the path (0 to 1.536 m/s between 0.15 s and 0.95 s)

clips.name: walk_stop
clips.prompt: a person walking forward slows down and stops, standing still
clips.note: starts in walk#1's frame 83 (the right heel comes down: the loop's start) at walk#1's speed; a left step, the right foot closes by 1.07 s, then the neutral pose

clips.name: run_start
clips.prompt: a person standing still starts running forward, pushing off with the right foot first
clips.note: right, left, right; ends as the right foot comes down in run#1's frame 91 (the loop's start) at run#1's speed. Seeds 0, 1, 3, 4, 5 step off with the left foot

clips.name: run_stop
clips.prompt: a person running forward slows down quickly and stops, standing still
clips.note: starts in run#1's frame 91 (the right foot comes down) at run#1's speed; three braking steps, still by 0.93 s

clips.name: jump_stand
clips.prompt: a person jumps straight up on the spot and lands
clips.note: in the air 0.63-1.10 s (0.47 s); the hips rise 0.38 m and the feet clear 0.27 m, less than the 0.45 m asked

clips.name: jump_forward
clips.prompt: a person running forward leaps forward over a gap, lands and keeps walking
clips.note: a leap off the left foot: in the air 0.97-1.43 s, against the path's hop window 0.95-1.394 s (1.674 m at 3.77 m/s, the rules' jump); a run-up at run#1's speed before, slowing to 1.9 m/s after. Only seeds 2, 4 and 7 leap; 4 and 7 are in the air too early or too long

clips.name: walk_back
clips.prompt: a person walks backward, looking straight ahead, arms swinging lightly
clips.note: cycle 1.10 s (x1.03 of walk#1) at 1.1 m/s: 1.22 m a cycle against walk#1's 1.70 m; hips ahead within 3 degrees; toe ends 1.8 cm under the floor at push-off (11 frames). Seeds 2 and 5 are cleaner on the floor at a 1.0 s and 0.97 s cycle

clips.name: run_back
clips.prompt: a person jogs backward, backpedaling, looking straight ahead
clips.note: a backward jog: cycle 0.73 s (x1.05 of run#1) at 2.0 m/s, 1.47 m a cycle against run#1's 2.30 m; almost no flight

clips.name: strafe_walk_left
clips.prompt: a person does a step touch to the left, over and over, arms relaxed at the sides
clips.note: a step touch: the only seed of 8 whose feet never cross (heels 9.5 to 77 cm apart). Slower than the walk: cycle 1.40 s (x1.31 of walk#1) at 0.46 m/s, 0.64 m a cycle. The relaxed-arm side-step prompts all crossed the trailing foot behind

clips.name: strafe_walk_right
clips.prompt: a person does a step touch to the right, over and over, arms relaxed at the sides
clips.note: a step touch, feet never cross (heels 4 to 76 cm apart); cycle 1.53 s (x1.44 of walk#1) at 0.44 m/s, 0.69 m a cycle. Seed 0 has the walk's cadence (1.13 s) and no crossing, but its chest turns up to 16 degrees and the arms lift

clips.name: strafe_run_left
clips.prompt: a person runs sideways to the left with crossover steps, chest facing forward
clips.note: crossover steps: cycle 0.70 s (x1.00 of run#1) at 2.0 m/s, 1.40 m a cycle against run#1's 2.30 m; chest within -9..5 degrees of ahead

clips.name: strafe_run_right
clips.prompt: a person runs sideways to the right with crossover steps, chest facing forward
clips.note: crossover steps: cycle 0.67 s (x0.95 of run#1) at 2.0 m/s, 1.33 m a cycle; chest within -7..1 degrees of ahead; toe ends 1.4 cm under the floor for 7 frames

clips.name: strafe_walk_cross_left
clips.prompt: a person steps sideways to the left
clips.note: not asked for: a sideways walk with the feet crossing, close to the forward walk: cycle 1.00 s (x0.94 of walk#1) at 1.3 m/s, 1.31 m a cycle; arms down

clips.name: strafe_walk_cross_right
clips.prompt: a person steps sideways to the right
clips.note: not asked for: a sideways walk with the feet crossing: cycle 0.90 s (x0.84 of walk#1) at 1.3 m/s, 1.18 m a cycle; arms down. Seeds 0 and 5 match the walk's cadence but hold the hands at chest height

clips.name: jump_back
clips.prompt: a person takes a big leap backward and lands
clips.note: from and to the neutral pose, not from a walk; in the air 0.70-1.03 s against the path's hop 0.6-1.044 s. Fails the floor on every seed: toe ends up to 3.7 cm under it for 20 frames here, the least of 8

clips.name: jump_left
clips.prompt: a person takes a big leap sideways to the left and lands
clips.note: from and to the neutral pose, not from a walk; in the air 0.67-1.00 s against the path's hop 0.6-1.044 s; feet clear 0.33 m; toe end 1.8 cm under the floor for 6 frames

clips.name: jump_right
clips.prompt: a person takes a big leap sideways to the right and lands
clips.note: from and to the neutral pose, not from a walk; in the air 0.70-1.03 s against the path's hop 0.6-1.044 s; toe ends 2.2 cm under the floor for 15 frames; the hips turn up to 7 degrees

clips.name: walk_diag_fl
clips.prompt: a person walks diagonally forward to the left, chest facing forward
clips.note: cycle 1.00 s (x0.94 of walk#1) at 1.4 m/s, 1.44 m a cycle; the feet cross; chest 3 to 10 degrees to the right of ahead

clips.name: walk_diag_fr
clips.prompt: a person walks diagonally forward to the right, chest facing forward
clips.note: cycle 1.00 s (x0.94 of walk#1) at 1.4 m/s, 1.39 m a cycle; the feet cross; chest within -7..8 degrees. Seed 0 has the walk's cycle but holds the hands at chest height

clips.name: walk_diag_bl
clips.prompt: a person walks backward diagonally to the left, looking straight ahead
clips.note: cycle 1.07 s (x1.00 of walk#1) at 1.1 m/s, 1.16 m a cycle; the feet cross; chest within -7..3 degrees

clips.name: walk_diag_br
clips.prompt: a person walks backward diagonally to the right, looking straight ahead
clips.note: cycle 1.07 s (x1.00 of walk#1) at 1.1 m/s, 1.16 m a cycle; the feet cross; chest within -6..4 degrees

clips.name: run_diag_fl
clips.prompt: a person runs diagonally forward to the left, chest facing forward
clips.note: cycle 0.73 s (x1.05 of run#1) at 2.6 m/s, 1.91 m a cycle; chest within -7..7 degrees. Seeds 1, 2 and 4 turn the chest 17 to 18 degrees

clips.name: run_diag_fr
clips.prompt: a person runs diagonally forward to the right, chest facing forward
clips.note: cycle 0.70 s (x1.00 of run#1) at 2.6 m/s, 1.84 m a cycle; chest up to 13 degrees to the left of ahead

clips.name: run_diag_bl
clips.prompt: a person jogs backward diagonally to the left, looking straight ahead
clips.note: a backward jog: cycle 0.77 s (x1.10 of run#1) at 2.0 m/s, 1.54 m a cycle; chest within -6..7 degrees

clips.name: run_diag_br
clips.prompt: a person jogs backward diagonally to the right, looking straight ahead
clips.note: a backward jog: cycle 0.73 s (x1.05 of run#1) at 2.0 m/s, 1.47 m a cycle; chest within -9..4 degrees
